ChannelsFinance on BSC was attacked, resulting in losses of over $320K. The contract uses an old Compound v2 protocol which has a known vulnerability.

Channels Finance was exploited on BNB Chain on December 30, 2023, through a share accounting flaw enabling 'Infinite Mint.' Attackers manipulated cToken shares to borrow unbacked assets, draining ~$320,000. The exploit abused improper supply checks; no official remediation or recovery is confirmed. The share accounting in Channels Finance's lending markets allowed attackers to mint shares without matching asset deposits ('Infinite Mint'), inflating borrowing power and draining pool assets. The root flaw was the lack of strict mapping between minted shares and collateral, compounded by rounding errors in the redemption function.
